name: editor-look
description: The chest editor window: the real K hotkey, hover hint, colour picker, attach list, free camera and how it feels

steps.message: Build a chest, look at it: is the '[K] Decorate chest' hint shown? Press K: does the editor open, and does Esc close it without the pause menu?
Colours tab: pick a colour, parts update live? Attach items tab: add 2 items, move / rotate / resize them. Is the free camera (orbit, zoom) comfortable?
Remove an attachment: are the paid materials refunded? Relog: is everything still there?
